flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: The biggest move came in [[Michigan]], where Polymarket odds show a sizable drop in the chances of the Democrat Abdul El-Sayed. In [[Maine]], the Democrat Troy Jackson gained ground in a race the market lists as a predicted flip. In [[Iowa]], the Republican Ashley Hinson also moved up modestly.
summaries.governor: In [[Georgia]], the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms gained a moderate amount of ground in Polymarket odds, and the market now calls it a predicted flip. In [[Florida]], the Republican Byron Donalds slipped by a moderate margin. In [[Kansas]], the Republican Ty Masterson edged up slightly, and that race is also a predicted flip.
summaries.house: The biggest move in the House today came in [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], where Polymarket odds show a sizable drop in the chances of the Republican, Brad Knott, against the Democrat Paul Barringer. In [[TX-23 (Del Rio & Eagle Pass)]], the Republican Brandon Herrera also lost ground, though by a moderate amount, with the Democrat being Katy Padilla Stout. Elsewhere, the market moved the other way in [[FL-13 (Clearwater & Largo)]], where the Republican Anna Paulina Luna gained moderate ground against the Democrat Leela Gray.
